text:
marta: Quick heads-up — kicking off the cloud catalog publish for AWS/GCP/Azure next week. Need to align AMI/container artifacts, EULA/legal packaging, trial SKU config, and terraform templates. Can folks confirm owners?

ben: I can take AWS listing + AMI build. What's the target timeline?

marta: Thanks — target publish window Wed 2026-04-07 -> internal QA Mon/Tue. So need artifacts by end of day Friday. Can you own AMI naming and shared S3 artifacts? :calendar:

kevin: I can do legal & EULA localization review. Two asks: 1) do we have a canonical privacy snippet for EU customers? 2) who owns entitlements mapping for trials?

lucy: I'll own terraform + publisher scripts. Need registry creds (GCP service account + Azure publisher access). Can we add an MFA exception for the CI bot?

marta: Action items:
- ben: AMI + container images, provide artifact URLs
- lucy: terraform templates + publish script
- kevin: EULA + trial entitlement mapping
- marta: coordinate listing metadata, screenshots, pricing bands

ben: plan: AMI names like `redwood-inf-ami-<region>-v<date>` and container tags `redwood/inference:prod-<sha>`

ben: snippet for AMI name:
```
redwood-inf-ami-us-west-2-v20260402
```

lucy: terraform var hint:
```
module "publisher" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood/publisher-terraform.git//aws"
  region = var.region
}
```

kevin: For EULA, I'll prepare a short EU privacy appendix. tagging @legal-channel once draft ready.

marta: Link to assets checklist: https://docs.redwood.com/marketplace/onboarding-checklist (please upload screenshots to the shared folder)

sam-bot: Reminder scheduled: `Marketplace Publish Sync` meeting on 2026-04-05 16:00 UTC — invites sent to @marta @ben @lucy @kevin

ben: I need AMI build runner access — @infra can you add `ci-ami-builder` to the AWS account? (cc: @marta)

lucy: Recorded: will put terraform PR template in `publisher-templates` repo and tag for review.

marta: Perfect. Let's aim to have all artifacts by EOD Friday. If blockers, drop them here and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:

kevin: Acknowledged. I'll post EULA draft by Thu morning.

ben: Acknowledged, starting AMI bake today.

lucy: Acknowledged — will create PR by tomorrow noon.

marta: Thanks team — will follow up with a one-pager for execs.
